between_attempt_learning: Use the map more often, keep awareness of aim-induced heading changes, use DASH to reposition and shorter movement bursts. USE assist worked near Mara but cannot substitute for safe traversal.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional in observed scope. Holistic judgment of observed mobile interaction, not win/loss or a completion grade. Limited early-game coverage; no inference of enjoyment in unassessed content.

reasons.overall_mobile: Strong visual identity and useful mobile assists supported meaningful progress, but route interpretation, collision and offscreen threat awareness repeatedly consumed attention and health. Second-run improvement shows learnability; it does not remove the friction.
reasons.controls: Tap aim, movement/fire together, USE assist and DASH worked. Aim alters travel heading; turning, navigation and multiple right-thumb actions were demanding. My own direction mistakes also contributed. No evidence of lost native touch input.
reasons.gameplay: Distinct charging Sentinel and Warden/optic prompts, receiver recoveries and healing created useful tactical decisions. Early patrol pressure repeatedly interrupted traversal; later combat and objectives unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain-soaked station, cyan relay, weapon and clearly framed terminal panels made a strong observed impression. Audio and hardware rendering quality not assessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, map pause, route distances, checkmarks, visible fresh reset and recovery assist were helpful. On-scene route cues and assist reach were less self-explanatory while under attack.
reasons.readability: Health, ammo, compass, receiver labels and buttons were readable at 844x390. Small threat/status/stat text and dark geometry demanded inspection; crowded right controls obscure part of the scene.
